label: SignoffsAndRunbookDrafts
payload:
1) Draft email to Finance and PM (send to each approver; paste their signed reply into PR #123):

Subject: Request: Signoff for revenue_adjustment business rule & precision (PR #123)

Hello <Name>,

We’re preparing PR #123 to add a new nullable invoice field revenue_adjustment (decimal, precision=12, scale=2). This change will persist a computed revenue_adjustment and expose revenue_adjustment and revenue_total in API/UI behind a feature flag. Before staging rollout, we need explicit business signoff that the calculation/business rule and the chosen precision (precision=12, scale=2) are acceptable.

Signoff template (please reply with this JSON filled and/or attach as a short email/snippet to the PR):
{
  "approver_name": "<Full Name>",
  "role": "Finance | Product Manager",
  "email": "<approver@example.com>",
  "timestamp": "<YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ>",
  "confirmation": "I approve business rule and decimal precision (precision=12, scale=2) for revenue_adjustment",
  "optional_comments": "<optional comments or blank>"
}

Requested ETA: within 2 business days. If you prefer, I can attach this draft as a PR comment for your convenience.

Thank you,
<Orchestrator or Planner signature>

---

2) Draft email to DBA (send to dba-team@your-org.com / dba-oncall):

Subject: Request DB approval: Backfill window & throttling for revenue_adjustment backfill (PR #123)

Hello DB team,

We plan a batched backfill to populate a new invoices.revenue_adjustment column. Please confirm/approve the backfill window, batch size, sleep/throttle, and whether an index is required. Proposed defaults:
- Proposed scheduled window (UTC): 02:00–05:00 UTC (low-traffic). Please propose an alternate window if needed.
- Proposed batch size: BACKFILL_BATCH_SIZE=1000
- Proposed throttle: BACKFILL_SLEEP_SECONDS=0.5
- Conservative alternative if DB load sensitive: 500 / 1.0
- Index guidance: Do NOT add an index by default; only if queries need it (adding index increases write overhead).

We will run a small staging test (one batch) and monitor DB metrics before proceeding to prod. Please reply with (a) approved or (b) adjustments and any scheduling constraints/maintenance window you require. Also confirm preferred checkpoint mechanism (file vs Redis/status table) and whether you want the job limited to low concurrency Sidekiq queue.

Please attach your reply to PR #123. Requested ETA: 1 business day.

Thanks,
<Orchestrator or Planner signature>

---

3) Detailed backfill runbook to attach to PR #123 (ready-to-paste)

Backfill runbook: revenue_adjustment backfill
- Purpose: populate invoices.revenue_adjustment for historical rows after deploying nullable column and tolerant code.
- Pre-reqs: migration applied to DB (nullable column added); staging backfill tested; DB backup taken within last 24 hours.
- Chosen parameters (subject to DBA approval):
  - Scheduled window: 02:00–05:00 UTC
  - BACKFILL_BATCH_SIZE: 1000
  - BACKFILL_SLEEP_SECONDS: 0.5
  - Runner: Sidekiq worker InvoiceRevenueBackfillWorker (maintenance queue) with Redis checkpoint REDIS_KEY='backfill:revenue_adjustment:last_id' OR rake task with resume file tmp/backfill_revenue_adjustment_resume
  - Concurrency: 1 worker (maintenance queue), no parallel workers unless DBA approves concurrency= N
- Checkpointing / Resume:
  - Worker writes last processed invoice id to Redis key; rake task writes last_id to tmp/backfill_revenue_adjustment_resume.
  - On restart, job resumes from last_id + 1.
- Monitoring thresholds/metrics to watch (fail-fast alerts):
  - DB CPU: abort if sustained > 80% for > 5 minutes
  - DB locks: abort if lock wait count spikes > 3x baseline or lock wait time avg > 2000ms
  - Replication lag (if applicable): abort if replication lag > 30s
  - Error rate: abort if more than 5% of rows in a batch fail with exceptions
  - API/Endpoint 500s: abort if invoices endpoints 500s increase > 1% above baseline
- Abort criteria and actions:
  - If any abort threshold hit: stop/backoff the job, notify DB/DevOps/Oncall, set feature flag OFF (if it was enabled), and investigate logs. Do NOT drop column or revert migration.
  - Manual resume: investigate cause, fix, then restart worker from checkpoint after DB/DevOps approval.
- Estimated duration examples:
  - 100k rows @ 10ms/row ~ 17 minutes + overhead
  - 1M rows ~ ~3 hours + overhead; tune batch size accordingly
- Safety measures:
  - Use update_columns to avoid callbacks, or use validated update if business requires validations for each invoice.
  - Idempotent updates: only write when computed value differs to reduce writes.
  - Run an initial dry-run sample: compute adjustments for a sample of 1000 invoices and validate results before full backfill.
- Logging and audit:
  - Log per-batch summary: start_id, end_id, processed_count, error_count, duration
  - Persist last_processed_id in checkpoint for audit
- Post-backfill verification:
  - Sample 10 invoices across date ranges and assert revenue_adjustment populated and revenue_total matches expected
  - Run BrowserTester E2E-3 (Backfill verification)
- Rollback if catastrophic: DO NOT drop column; instead toggle feature_flag OFF and, if necessary, restore DB from backup (last resort, after leadership/DBA approval)

---

4) Feature-flag config snippet to add to PR (show default OFF in prod) — Flipper example

  enabled_in_production: false
  enabled_in_staging: false

Include the config file path in PR and a short note: "Feature flag revenue_adjustment default OFF in production; enable selectively after QA signoff."

---

Comment to post on PR #123:

- Finance signoff: <Name> (<email>) at <timestamp> — [attached snippet/link]
- PM signoff: <Name> (<email>) at <timestamp> — [attached snippet/link]
- DBA approval: <Name/team> (<email>) at <timestamp> — confirmed backfill window <02:00–05:00 UTC> and throttling BACKFILL_BATCH_SIZE=<value> / BACKFILL_SLEEP_SECONDS=<value> (or listed adjustments)

Backfill runbook summary included (batch size, sleep, checkpointing, monitoring thresholds, abort criteria). Feature flag revenue_adjustment default set to OFF in production (Flipper snippet included).

Next steps: Implementer may open/apply PR artifacts, run staging backfill & E2E tests; BrowserTester to schedule E2E in staging after code deployed and flag toggled for QA. If any approver requested changes, see their comments above and Planner will replan accordingly.

(Planner)"

---

7) If you want me to send the actual emails on your behalf (draft ready), reply 'DraftEmail' and provide approver emails and the mailbox/sender to use; otherwise send from your mailbox and paste replies into PR #123.
